{{TagLine|AC750 Dual-Band WiFi Router}} "EWW302-A1-BL-015" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. All of the following devices are internally identical: * [[Linksys E5400]] - ''AC1200 Dual-Band WiFi Router'' * [[Linksys E5350]] - ''AC1000 Dual-Band WiFi Router'' * [[Linksys E5300]] - ''AC750 Dual-Band WiFi Router'' * [[Linksys E2500 v4]] - ''N600 Dual-Band WiFi Router'' {{WiFiCert|WFA81721|01/25/2019}} :We are guessing that one of the two spatial streams present in the 5GHz radio is disabled :which limits the maximum rate of 5GHz 802.11ac from 867Mbps to 433Mbps.
